# BASS 2.4

This directory contains the official 64-bit Windows BASS runtime, import library,
and C header downloaded from <https://www.un4seen.com/bass.html>.

The upstream terms are reproduced in `BASS-LICENSE.txt`. BASS is free for
non-commercial use; commercial distribution requires the appropriate Un4seen
licence. Keeping these files in the source tree does not grant a commercial
licence.
